reffreq.scope: Read and ignored by reader; catalog refuses non-default in every mode (issue 980).

nchan.scope: In cube, positive value supplies output count; -1 uses casa-rs channel_count. MFS ignores this count. Derived CASA extent cases are refused (issue 980).

width.scope: MFS ignores it; cube copies text. Some nchan=-1 derived extents are refused (issue 980).

outframe.scope: MFS only accepts CASA default LSRK; cube accepts LSRK/BARY/TOPO/REST case-insensitively and uppercases; other frames refused (issue 980).

veltype.scope: MFS ignores it; cube maps radio->RADIO, optical/z->OPTICAL, beta/relativistic/true->BETA; other values refused (issue 980).

restfreq.scope: Explicit MFS restfreq still requires empty; cube accepts zero or one frequency. The ordinary empty MFS default now reads SOURCE metadata using first selected SPW and CASA-VI field ordering; DOPPLER-backed lookup and multiple SOURCE key groups with stored wildcards explicitly refuse as unfinished (#980).

interpolation.scope: MFS ignores it; cube forwards it except cubic, which is refused (issue 823).

behaviors.scope: specmode, spw, start, width, nchan, reffreq, restfreq, outframe, veltype, interpolation and perchanweightdensity.
behaviors.gap: Cube channel-count mapping exists, but selected-channel-derived defaults are refused; MFS frame/rest-frequency forms, multiple rest frequencies and cubic interpolation remain restricted. Moving-source cubesource needs its own representative oracle (#714). MVC removal is a separate prior owner decision, not a passing moving-source comparison. DOPPLER-backed SOURCE lookup and multiple SOURCE key groups with stored wildcards are explicitly unfinished, not approved deviations.

behaviors.title: Gridder, weighting and beam combinations
behaviors.scope: standard/W/mosaic/AW, rectangular geometry, facets, normtype, beam terms and density weighting.
behaviors.gap: Rectangular standard/W/mosaic and uvtaper were implemented in #970. AW remains square/equal-cell, MFS-only, with fixed A/WB/conjugate terms and no PS term. Mosaic per-field density weighting is refused (#818); W/AW facets and additional gridders/weightings remain incomplete. Native CF generation is verified separately from CASA cache oracles. The native write_pb default is True. Homogeneous ALMA-labelled 7m arrays select ACA; legacy VLA PB now covers all named bands and NVSS frequency gaps. Fresh ordinary-default W/Hogbom20 CPU64/CPU32 runs pass all seven products, with PB NRMS zero. Moving/nonconstant FIELD directions, mixed dish classes, unsupported telescopes and remaining EVLA bands are unfinished. Explicit GPU W/AW remains refused. CASA Float channel-frequency narrowing is now matched in shared Taylor factors. All five fresh mosaic/native-AW MT-MFS rows pass the owner-approved scoped weak weight.tt1 rule and retained original recorded checks; 3 override only raw weight.tt1 relative-error failures. Exact guards and 1e-6 matrix-scale limits remain. Full metadata is separate. Existing #690 odd-sumwt scaling remains distinct.

behaviors.title: Deconvolution, masks and stopping
behaviors.scope: Hogbom, Clark, multiscale, MT-MFS, iteration controls, user masks and auto-multithresh.
behaviors.gap: The owner approved contract31's native CASA-inclusive Hogbom default, preserving explicit strict. Normal-build ordinary Hogbom10 point-source comparisons pass seven products on CPU64/CPU32/GPU32 with no explicit accounting option; prototype ALMA mosaic CLEAN also passes in that mode. Independent default-continuation and migration tests pass. ASP, MEM, Clark-Stokes, MT-MFS nterms=1, PB masks/pbsquare, several auto-mask controls, explicit restoring beams and nmajor=0 are incomplete or refused. Compare convergence/flux/beam and exact mask support separately; nonlinear component identity is not required, but approved mode-specific gates stay binding. The owner accepted only the original identity-bound b6a87 clean8/cpu32 weak model result; raw model.tt1 NRMS 0.0012759712 remains recorded. No general weak-model waiver or automatic future-output acceptance exists. Explicit all-zero mask input currently errors where CASA returns stop7; this is an unfinished bug.
